name: Consultant, Full-Stack Developer
description:
Leading enterprise-scale solutions and driving technical direction as a consultant for global clients.

- Lead development of cloud-native enterprise solutions using Azure, .NET, and the Microsoft ecosystem.  
- Architect and deliver scalable applications with Infrastructure as Code and clean architectural patterns.  
- Mentor developers and interns across client and internal projects, fostering team growth.  
- Drive agile practices as a hands-on Scrum practitioner focused on continuous improvement.  
- Partner closely with clients to turn business requirements into secure, high-performance solutions.

name: Senior Analyst, Full-Stack Developer
description:
Delivered enterprise-grade solutions across the full stack, gaining deep expertise in Azure and the Microsoft ecosystem.

- Developed and maintained enterprise solutions using Azure, .NET, and modern frontend frameworks.  
- Championed code quality through clean code principles, resulting in maintainable, testable software.  
- Collaborated with clients across multiple sectors to design secure, high-performance applications.  
- Mentored junior team members and contributed to internal knowledge-sharing initiatives.  
- Promoted agile development practices and continuous delivery across client engagements.

name: Analyst Developer
description:
Built public-sector digital services at the Belgian National Employment Office (ONEM) through Smals, a non-profit IT partner for government institutions.

- Contributed to mainframe system migration to Linux and modernization of legacy systems.  
- Maintained a C++ shared library on Linux and supported a custom mainframe emulator.  
- Developed web applications using Angular, Spring Boot, Docker, and Kubernetes for government workflows.  
- Automated deployments with Atlassian Bamboo, improving release speed and reliability.  
- Implemented testing strategies with Cypress, Cucumber, Jest, and JUnit to ensure code quality.

name: Software Engineer Intern
description:
Developed a cloud-native proof-of-concept and Azure DevOps tooling as part of a competitive internship program.

- Designed and built a cloud-native PoC application using React, TypeScript, Azure Functions (.NET), and Azure Storage Tables.  
- Created Azure DevOps web extensions for agile team mood tracking and reporting.  
- Implemented automated build and deployment workflows within the Azure ecosystem.  
- Delivered technical demos to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.  
- Applied clean code and security best practices with a focus on scalability.

name: Software Engineer Intern
description:
Selected for a competitive prototyping internship program, working on an Avanade-sponsored project with mentorship from Microsoft.

- Trained in Scrum, Python, Node.js, Angular, React, Big Data, and IoT through expert-led workshops.  
- Contributed to innovation projects supporting startups and entrepreneurs in the local tech ecosystem.  
- Developed technical and soft skills through mentorship sessions and hands-on prototyping.  
- Adapted to remote collaboration during the coronavirus outbreak, maintaining productivity through online supervision.
